goal: Create reusable UI primitives and the first Visual Token Lab for ALINA/FATHER.
why: Validate that ALINA can provide a compact, sufficient engineering context while Makar turns design tokens into visible production-grade UI.
constraints: Do not hard-code raw theme colors inside shared primitives
Generic UI must not import ALINA-specific business logic
Mock data must be visibly marked
3D is out of scope for this task
project_decisions: ALINA gets a theme, not a fork of the shared token model
Visual effects communicate state/hierarchy, not decoration only
acceptance_criteria: GlassPanel, Button, IconButton, Badge, StatusIndicator, MetricCard, NavigationItem and CommandBar exist as reusable components
A visual lab demonstrates typography, glass, glow, depth, status and motion states
No raw ALINA theme colors are embedded in shared components
Laptop, desktop and ultrawide layouts remain usable
test_contract: Visual screenshots are produced at representative widths
dependencies: PR #2 must be merged or its token branch must be explicitly consumed
open_questions: Should the first lab live inside ALINA or a dedicated lab app after the initial proof?
